The Sacred Ruins, Sheng Xu, 圣墟, Lucifer Donghua, Chinese Anime Donghua Stream, ( chinese anime | donghua 2026 ) 1st season All episodes English sub
In a world transformed by a mysterious global catastrophe, ordinary college graduate Chu Feng witnesses the beginning of a new age where ancient ruins awaken, mythical creatures return, and all living beings begin to evolve. As Earth is reshaped by powerful energies, humans, beasts, and forgotten civilizations battle for survival and supremacy.
After obtaining a rare opportunity to cultivate, Chu Feng embarks on a dangerous journey through sacred ruins and hidden realms, growing from an ordinary young man into one of the strongest cultivators. Along the way, he uncovers shocking secrets about Earth's past, the origins of evolution, and the cosmic forces manipulating countless worlds. With powerful enemies closing in from every direction, Chu Feng must forge his own path to protect those he loves and challenge the beings who rule the universe.
